editorial.blurb: Kapitan brings authentic Malaysian and Singaporean flavors to Chicago with dishes that transport you straight to Southeast Asia.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the beef rendang or nasi lemak with lamb shank for deeply flavorful, slow-cooked proteins; add the butterfly pea mocktail with lemon juice for a sweet, visually stunning pairing. The Singapore curry laksa hits the spot on quieter weeknights when you can snag a table easily.
